cover: Eight killed, three at Gaza university
Curbs stay as CM meets dam groups

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.place: Gaza City and Khan Younis, Gaza
stories.head: Strikes hit Gaza's Islamic University
bullets: Israeli strikes killed at least eight people across Gaza on Sunday, three of them security guards at the Islamic University.
Seven female students were hurt in an earlier strike on the campus.
Gaza's Health Ministry counts 1,551 killed since the ceasefire. No Israeli military comment was reported.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Village attack toll rises to 40
bullets: Armed men attacked Binnari village on Friday, burning homes, shops and food.
Amnesty says at least 40 were killed; police had confirmed 10, and many are missing.
Police say officers were deployed to restore order. No group has been named.

stories.label: India · Vote · Due process
stories.head: Voter-deletion forms with no reason
bullets: Election officials filed at least 61,059 forms to delete names from Karnataka's rolls; none gave the reason the rules require, The Hindu found.
Most came after the 23 September deadline.
Officials say the system auto-generated them when voters could not be reached.

stories.label: India · Assembly · Land
stories.head: Curbs stay after Siang dam unrest
bullets: Prohibitory orders stayed in force in parts of East Siang on Sunday; officials reported no fresh violence.
Chief Minister Pema Khandu met community groups and MLAs, blaming 'misinformation' for fears over the dam.
Protest groups want the project scrapped and 10 arrested activists freed.
